front.title: John
front.theme: FROM DUST TO THE RESURRECTION AND THE LIFE

back.kicker: PART THREE · THE RESURRECTION AND THE LIFE
back.hook: A man four days in the dust heard one word and walked out.
paragraphs: John 11–16 begins at a tomb in Bethany and ends on the night before the cross. Jesus calls a dead man by name, washes the feet of men who will fail Him, and promises another Counselor.
Twelve weeks walk from Lazarus to the last supper — the grain of wheat, the cross lifted up, the Father's house, the true Vine, and a Lord who has overcome the world.
items: The full passage in the World English Bible
Five Greek word studies, each with a Live It response
Five Life Application practices and a daily prayer
A Bottom Line and a “Lift Up Your Eyes” benediction
